title: Ventilution PMCF-Study
summary:
Ventilution is a non invasive system for Active Dead space Reduction (ADR) during invasive ventilation. For usage, it is coupled in parallel to the breathing system in addition to the respirator.

This Post-Market Clinical Follow-Up study aims to get clinical data regarding safety and efficacy of the Ventilution System from daily usage.

interventions.name: Adult patients on invasive ventilation where the Ventilution System is applied for reduction of respiratory dead space

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Usage of Ventilution within intended use and by trained users
written consent of patient or authorized representative
Exclusion criteria:
Applicability of contraindications for the use of Ventilution
Missing written consent of patient or authorized representative
